name: kompare
description: Kompare – one app to compare prices, track price history and order across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and more.

scripts.build:app: tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts --mode mobile
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:app && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:open: npm run build:app && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.preview:app: npm run build:app && npx vite preview --config web/vite.config.ts --mode mobile --port 4173
